SELECT
FROM sensor_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(sensor_data, '$.${fieldPath}') as field_value FROM sensor_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND JSON_EXTRACT(sensor_data, '$.${fieldPath}') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(sensor_data, '$.slaves') as slaves FROM sensor_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND JSON_EXTRACT(sensor_data, '$.slaves') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(sensor_data, CONCAT('$.slaves[', #{index}, ']')) as slave_data FROM sensor_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND JSON_EXTRACT(sensor_data, CONCAT('$.slaves[', #{index}, ']')) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sensor_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY timestamp DESC
